correctness.rationale: Independently inverted the actual frozen RESULT.md two-stage implicit 2×2 linear system and symbolically verified B(s,t), trace −(4st+2s+10t−3)/(2s²+4s+3), determinant 2t(t−2)/(2s²+4s+3), and all three quadratic Jury identities. The real split strip follows from middle Jury polynomial (s−t)²+s−7t+3≥0 and strict ordering 0<T(s)<P(s)<U(s). At t=T(s) the −1 eigenvalue is simple, zero-split eigenvalues are 0,1 simple, so full three-stage matrix is power bounded; above T(s) a root has modulus >1. For fixed t=cs, 0<c<1, as s→∞ the active block tends to cJ=c(−I+N), N²=0, ||N||₂=3; exact powers give (1−c)max_n||(cJ)^n||₂→3/e. Taking each finite n first and then sufficiently large but finite stable s establishes no UNIFORM bound across the stable family; no single finite B is asserted power-unbounded. A standalone independent SymPy derivation confirms the algebra; finite checks are supplementary.
